livingCosts.notes: Cambridge 'Living costs' indicative monthly costs for 2027-28 (latest published; includes projected inflation): accommodation £880, food £255, personal items £75, social activities £85, study costs £10, miscellaneous £25; total £1,330/month, £11,970 for 9 months (£15,960 for 12). Personal = personal items + social + study + miscellaneous. Transport is not itemised (Cambridge says most students walk or cycle), so 0.

programmes.name: The Cambridge MBA (Judge Business School)
programmes.notes: Same fee for Home and Overseas; 1-year programme. Application fee £165 not included. The 2025 figure is from a secondary source, not confirmed on an official page.
